report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned HTTP 200 with 63-172ms durations; metrics show /v1/checkout 200s with zero 502s and p95 ~247ms. Traces show successful end-to-end checkout spans across order, inventory, payment, redis and postgres with no errors. No fault is established by current evidence; the operator alert is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off rather than assert a bounded cause.
missing_evidence: Logs (ev-...-gw_logs) were excluded from context; needed to check for errors or warnings behind the healthy status codes.
No downstream service metrics/traces for order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres to confirm or rule out downstream-latency.
No baseline latency SLO/threshold to judge whether 63-172ms checkout durations are anomalous.
No evidence of connection pool saturation, redis timeouts, or 5xx errors to support any taxonomy cause.
